title: Animated Reaction Captions — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: It clicks into a system
scenes.purpose: Show reaction-caption craft: layered sticker lettering pops in with spring, squash and wobble on a stationary navy halftone field, then the idea connects into a system.
visuals: Deep ink-navy field with tone-on-tone halftone dot grid (stationary)
Orange idea node with Rough.js sketch ring
'IT CLICKS!' Impact headline: orange fill, dark stroke, cream keyline, hard shadow
Blue ring pulse behind headline and seeded confetti burst
Purple WOW starburst sticker with impact ticks
Dotted cream connectors drawing node to node
Blue 'now it's a SYSTEM' pill caption
assets: Rough.js seeded paths embedded in index.html

beats.development: The orange idea node pops in and a sketch ring circles it. The 'one tiny idea…' caption pops up with a tilt and settles.

'IT CLICKS!' slams in, squashes, wobbles and settles upright. Rings pulse out, confetti bursts, an underline scribbles in and the WOW sticker twists in with impact ticks. The first link draws from the idea node to the headline.
Dotted links grow along the path. The blue node pops when its link arrives, then the purple node pops. The 'now it's a SYSTEM' pill rises with its label already inside, and the sparkles twinkle in.
Fully settled reading hold of the complete composition.

findings: The headline is fully legible from 1.47s. It gets about 1.5s of static exposure before the end.
All motion finishes by 2.48s, before the 2.7s settle requirement.
The background and dot grid never move.
justifiedHolds: 2.48–3.0s: final hold so all four captions can be read together.

notes: Silent preview with no audio track.

Recipe demonstrated: the source-frame refresh (BACKGROUND_REVIEW, ayumi-t820 lessons). It uses a scene-dependent ink-navy halftone field instead of the prior cream, a fill + dark stroke + cream keyline + hard shadow caption stack, ring pulse and confetti on the payoff, and pop-in tilt with overshoot that settles upright. STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes is empty.
Accent roles are kept: orange #DA855C for the headline, blue #668FA3 for the system pill, purple #A47CA3 for the WOW sticker.
